data_description.target_entity: The target must support setting a single target temperature.
data_description.period_count: Creates this many independently editable start times and temperatures.

standard_temperature.title: Standard temperature
standard_temperature.description: Used while the schedule is off and the standard temperature switch is on. Both switches are off after installation.

error.target_temperature_not_supported: The selected entity does not support a target temperature.

abort.already_configured: A schedule is already installed for this climate entity.

overview.title: Schedule periods
overview.description: Target: {target}. Select a period to edit it. The target is fixed, and changes are applied only after you select Save changes.

period_count.title: Number of periods
period_count.description: Target: {target}. Reducing the number removes the last periods.

period.title: Period {number}
period.description: Change this period's state, start time, and target temperature, then return to the period list.

data_description.use_standard_temperature: When enabled, this period follows the standard temperature. Its own target temperature is ignored. This works independently of the switch for standard temperature when the schedule is off.

standard_temperature.title: Standard temperature
standard_temperature.description: Used while the schedule is off and the standard temperature switch is on. Both switches are off after installation.
